function.description: Broadcast the conversion `WalletWrapPrepare` prepared. This is the call that SPENDS REAL FUNDS: it signs with the user's wallet and sends an IRREVERSIBLE transaction. WHO CALLS THIS: you do, with the intentId prepare returned - over MCP Vex dispatches nothing on your behalf. APPROVAL: over MCP in a restricted project the call WAITS until the user answers the Vex card, which IS the confirmation - do not ask for one again in chat. It returns the settled outcome: executed (this tool's own status: confirmed, confirmed_unrecorded or pending - poll it, never re-send), declined, expired, refused, dispatch_failed or indeterminate; never call it twice while you wait; never retry an indeterminate one. In a full project it executes directly under standing permission. Nothing is signed, decrypted or consumed until it is authorized. BEFORE IT SIGNS it re-reads the selected wallet, requires the chain and the verified wrapped-native contract to be the ones the intent bound, RE-DERIVES the whole `{to, data, value}` triple from the approved direction, contract and amount, compares it byte for byte, and re-simulates. FAILURE MODES, each leaving NOTHING SIGNED and no funds moved: a proposal digest that does not match the row, an approval bound to another proposal, an EXPIRED, ALREADY-CONSUMED or cancelled intent (an approval is never reusable), and a re-derived transaction that differs in any field. The approved gas caps are enforced on what is signed: a limit or price above them refuses. THE CONVERSION IS EXACTLY 1:1, the recipient is always the signer, and VEX CHARGES NO FEE - only network gas inside the approved caps. RETURNS the outcome and the fields named in the result: confirmed, reverted on-chain, broadcast with confirmation UNKNOWN, or failed before broadcast - and only the last is safe to prepare again, because a reverted transaction is real and paid a network fee and an unknown one may still be settling: Vex tracks it and NEVER re-sends it, and neither should you. Full contract: vex_ToolDescribe.
function.name: WalletWrapConfirm

intentId.description: The intent id that `WalletWrapPrepare` returned. It is scoped to this session and to the exact conversion that was approved.
